chunks.arabic_text: عَدَدٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا، عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عِيسَى، عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ، عَنْ أَبَانَ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي يَعْفُورَ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ خَطَبَ النَّاسَ فِي مَسْجِدِ الْخَيْفِ

translations.en: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Isa, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Ibn Abi Ya'fur, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) addressed the people in the Masjid of al-Khif

chunks.arabic_text: فَقَالَ: نَضَّرَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا سَمِعَ مَقَالَتِي فَوَعَاهَا وَحَفِظَهَا وَبَلَّغَهَا مَنْ لَمْ يَسْمَعْهَا، فَرُبَّ حَامِلِ فِقْهٍ غَيْرُ فَقِيهٍ، وَرُبَّ حَامِلِ فِقْهٍ إِلَى مَنْ هُوَ أَفْقَهُ مِنْهُ …

translations.en: and said: May Allah make radiant [the face of] a slave who hears my words, understands them, memorizes them, and conveys them to the one who did not hear them, for it may happen that a bearer of Fiqh is not a Faqih, and it may happen that a bearer of Fiqh relays them to one who is more of a Faqih than him …

en.summary: This hadith, recorded in Al-Kafi and cited in Al-Muhsini's work, underscores the Shia emphasis on the chain of transmission (isnad) and the dynamic nature of knowledge dissemination, where the act of conveying wisdom is valued even if the transmitter is not the ultimate authority. It highlights the concept of 'rabbahim al-fiqh ghayr faqih' (one who carries jurisprudence but is not a jurist), illustrating that knowledge flows of learning often move from less knowledgeable to more knowledgeable individuals, ensuring the preservation and deepening of religious understanding. This principle supports the authority of solitary reports (khabar al-wahid) from truthful narrators, a key topic in the referenced chapter.
en.seo_question: What is the significance of 'carrier of Fiqh' in Shia hadith regarding knowledge transmission?

key_terms.فِقْه: Jurisprudence or deep understanding of religious law
key_terms.فَقِيه: A jurist or one who possesses deep understanding
key_terms.مَسْجِدُ الْخَيْفِ: The Mosque of al-Khif, a location near Mecca
